ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is predominantly solid black with isolated white speckles. Right lobe contains a large, irregular high-contrast white patch extending from the mid-section toward the distal tip, characterized by mottled edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression at the center-point; angle approximately 35-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing boundary, with peak amplitudes reaching 5-10 pixels in height relative to the base curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a broad convex curvature; right lobe follows an upward diagonal trajectory with a slightly more linear trailing edge profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, circular, high-intensity white clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated heavily on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct, horizontal white linear marks (rake marks) situated on the dark pigmentation near the central notch area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both lobe tips, creating a textured, multi-layered protrusion that alters the natural geometric tip profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between the nearly all-black left lobe and the partially white right lobe.
